events.name: Vanderbilt Commodores at Georgia Bulldogs
Notre Dame Fighting Irish at North Carolina Tar Heels

headlines.description: — Notre Dame abruptly found itself playing in a tight game at North Carolina with the pouring rain limiting coach Marcus Freeman’s comfort throwing the ball.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr, ground game help No. 3 Notre Dame push past North Carolina 37-26 for 15th straight win

events.name: Miami Hurricanes at Clemson Tigers

headlines.description: — Darian Mensah threw for 227 yards and a touchdown and had a 34-yard scoring run as No. 4 Miami routed Clemson 41-13 on Saturday night to seize sole possession of first place in the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Darian Mensah, Mark Fletcher Jr. lead unbeaten No. 4 Miami past Clemson 41-13

events.name: Ohio State Buckeyes at Iowa Hawkeyes
Indiana Hoosiers at Rutgers Scarlet Knights

headlines.description: — Turbo Richard ran for 204 yards and a touchdown, Josh Hoover passed for 251 yards and four touchdowns and No. 6 Indiana beat Rutgers 47-15 on Saturday night for its 21st straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richard runs for 204 yards, TD in No. 6 Indiana's 47-15 romp over Rutgers

events.name: Alabama Crimson Tide at Mississippi State Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Keelon Russell passed for 285 yards and three touchdowns to go with a rushing score, and No. 7 Alabama routed 16th-ranked Mississippi State 56-23 on Saturday in a matchup of previously unbeaten teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keelon Russell accounts for 4 TDs as No. 7 Alabama routs No. 16 Mississippi State 56-23

events.name: Florida Gators at Missouri Tigers

headlines.description: — Austin Simmons threw for 340 yards and two touchdowns, Jamal Roberts ran for 211 yards and three more scores, and No. 25 Missouri trounced eighth-ranked Florida 45-17 on Saturday to snap a nine-game losing streak against ranked opponents.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 25 Missouri trounces No. 8 Florida 45-17 to snap 9-game skid against Top 25 opponents

events.name: BYU Cougars at TCU Horned Frogs

headlines.description: — BYU quarterback Bear Bachmeier ran for two touchdowns, the second a clinching 21-yarder with 2:06 left, and the No. 10 Cougars overcame an injury to running back LJ Martin in a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bear Bachmeier runs for 2 TDs as No. 10 BYU overcomes loss of LJ Martin to beat TCU 17-10

events.name: McNeese Cowboys at LSU Tigers

headlines.description: — Sam Leavitt threw for 173 yards and three touchdowns and No. 11 LSU beat McNeese State 63-14 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Leavitt leads LSU to 63-14 victory over McNeese State

events.name: Texas Tech Red Raiders at Colorado Buffaloes

headlines.description: — Linebacker John Curry picked off a pass in the end zone for an easy touchdown, one of four interceptions for No. 12 Texas Tech in a 29-7 win over mistake-prone Colorado on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 12 Texas Tech capitalizes on 4 interceptions in a 29-7 win over Colorado and moves to 5-0

events.name: Auburn Tigers at Tennessee Volunteers

headlines.description: — DeSean Bishop rushed for a career-high 220 yards and three touchdowns to lead No. 17 Tennessee to a 24-14 victory over Auburn on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bishop rushes for 220 yards, 3 TDs to lead No. 17 Tennessee over Auburn 24-14

events.name: Washington Huskies at USC Trojans

headlines.description: — Jahkeem Stewart returned a fumble 48 yards for the go-ahead touchdown, and No. 18 Southern California overcame a double-digit deficit in the second half for a 25-21 victory over Washington on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 18 USC rallies past Washington 25-21 with Stewart's fumble return TD, more big defensive plays

events.name: UCF Knights at Houston Cougars

headlines.description: — Conner Weigman threw for 239 yards and rushed for three second-half touchdowns, and No. 20 Houston rallied to beat Central Florida 27-17 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conner Weigman's 3 second-half touchdowns rally No. 20 Houston past UCF 27-17

events.name: Boston College Eagles at SMU Mustangs
Utah State Aggies at Boise State Broncos

headlines.description: — Maddux Madsen was 17-of-21 passing for 244 yards and two touchdowns, Dylan Riley added two rushing touchdowns and No. 22 Boise State beat Utah State 37-18 on Saturday in the inaugural game as a member of the Pac-12 Conference for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Madsen, No. 22 Boise State beat Utah State 37-18 in the teams' inaugural Pac-12 game

events.name: Kentucky Wildcats at South Carolina Gamecocks
Memphis Tigers at Charlotte 49ers

headlines.description: — Marcus Stokes threw for a career-high five touchdowns and Memphis routed Charlotte 59-8 on Saturday in an American Conference opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stokes throws for career-high 5TDs in Memphis' 59-8 drubbing of Charlotte

events.name: Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders at Kansas Jayhawks

headlines.description: — Dylan Edwards rushed for 137 yards and three touchdowns as Kansas trounced Middle Tennessee 55-0 Saturday to snap a two-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rushing attack, strong defense lead Kansas past Middle Tennessee

events.name: West Virginia Mountaineers at Iowa State Cyclones

headlines.description: — Aiden Flora accounted for five touchdowns, including the go-ahead score with 1:57 left, and Iowa State held off West Virginia 45-42 Saturday in a wild game in which the teams combined for over 1,000 yards of offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aiden Flora accounts for 5 TDs as Iowa State outlasts West Virginia in a wild 45-42 victory

events.name: Stanford Cardinal at Wake Forest Demon Deacons

headlines.description: — Gio Lopez ran for three touchdowns and passed for two more as Wake Forest beat Stanford 57-3 in record-setting fashion on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lopez accounts for five TDs as Wake Forest beats Stanford 57-3

events.name: Syracuse Orange at UConn Huskies

headlines.description: — Just two days after Amari Odom was told he would be the starting quarterback in Syracuse's road game against UConn, the ball was in his hands with the Orange looking to leave Rentschler Field on a winning note.
headlines.shortLinkText: Amari Odom's 6 TDs and 2-point conversion help Syracuse survive UConn 42-41 in overtime

events.name: Michigan Wolverines at Minnesota Golden Gophers
Navy Midshipmen at Air Force Falcons

headlines.description: — Liam Szarka rushed for two touchdowns and Air Force defeated Navy 14-9 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Air Force beats Navy 14-9 to get jump on Commander-in-Chief's Trophy competition

events.name: Michigan State Spartans at Wisconsin Badgers
Western Michigan Broncos at Buffalo Bulls

headlines.description: — Dieter Kelly kicked the go-ahead field goal with 79 seconds remaining and the Western Michigan defense held on fourth-and-goal with two seconds left in a 20-17 victory over Buffalo on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Western Michigan goes ahead late in the fourth, holds on for victory when Buffalo goes for the win

events.name: Toledo Rockets at Ball State Cardinals

headlines.description: — CJ Miller and Connor Walendzak combined for 299 yards rushing and three touchdowns to lead Toledo to a 39-24 victory over Ball State on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for the Rockets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller and Walendzak combine for nearly 300 yards rushing, lead Toledo to 39-24 win over Ball State

events.name: California Golden Bears at UNLV Rebels

headlines.description: — Jackson Arnold passed and ran for 287 yards and five touchdowns to lead UNLV to a 39-31 victory over short-handed California on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Arnold accounts for 5 TDs as UNLV beats California 39-31

events.name: Louisville Cardinals at NC State Wolfpack

headlines.description: — CJ Bailey threw for a career-high 373 yards and two touchdowns as N.C. State held on to beat Louisville 31-28 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bailey's career-high 373 yards passing, 2 TDs lead NC State past Louisville 31-28

events.name: Virginia Cavaliers at Florida State Seminoles

headlines.description: — Ashton Daniels had five rushing touchdowns, setting a record for a Florida State quarterback, and the Seminoles had 10 sacks in a 38-7 rout of Virginia on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ashton Daniels sets Florida State quarterback record with 5 rushing TDs in 38-7 rout of Virginia

events.name: Samford Bulldogs at UAB Blazers

headlines.description: — Ryder Burton threw for a touchdown, Jonah Delange kicked four field goals and UAB's defense came up with three interceptions in a 33-14 win over Samford on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: UAB needs the 4th quarter to pull away from Samford in 33-14 victory

events.name: Wyoming Cowboys at North Dakota State Bison

headlines.description: — Nathan Hayes ran for two touchdowns and North Dakota State's defense smothered Wyoming in a 28-0 win on Saturday in the Bison's first-ever Mountain West Conference home game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan Hayes runs for 2 TDs, Bison defense stellar in 28-0 win over Wyoming

events.name: Akron Zips at Central Michigan Chippewas

headlines.description: — Angel Flores rushed for 154 yards and a touchdown and threw for another score as Central Michigan beat Akron 41-17 on Saturday in a Mid-American Conference opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angel Flores has TD pass, scoring run as Central Michigan beats Akron 41-17 in MAC opener

events.name: Eastern Michigan Eagles at Massachusetts Minutemen

headlines.description: — Noah Kim threw for 219 yards and two touchdowns as Eastern Michigan beat Massachusetts 38-14 on Saturday to improve to 2-0 in Mid-American Conference play for the first time since 2005.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noah Kim tosses 2 TDs to help Eastern Michigan beat UMass 38-14

events.name: Ohio Bobcats at Kent State Golden Flashes

headlines.description: — Matt Vezza had a touchdown run, Will Hryszko made two field goals and Ohio won its Mid-American Conference opener with a 13-10 victory over Kent State on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matt Vezza's TD proves difference in Ohio's 13-10 win over Kent State

events.name: Bowling Green Falcons at Miami (OH) RedHawks

headlines.description: — Leo Kemp scored on a 2-yard run with 7 seconds remaining, lifting Bowling Green over Miami of Ohio 24-20 on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leo Kemp's touchdown in waning seconds lifts Bowling Green to 24-20 win over Miami of Ohio

events.name: Old Dominion Monarchs at Georgia State Panthers

headlines.description: — Cameran Brown threw a school-record six touchdown passes and Georgia State flew past Old Dominion 42-10 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cameran Brown's school-record 6 touchdown passes lead Georgia State to 42-10 rout of Old Dominion

events.name: Marshall Thundering Herd at James Madison Dukes

headlines.description: — Camden Coleman threw three touchdown passes, and George Pettaway rushed for two scores and a career-high 206 yards to lead unbeaten James Madison to a 45-17 victory over Marshall on Saturday in the Thundering Herd's Sun Belt Conference opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Camden Coleman, George Pettaway lead unbeaten James Madison to 45-17 romp over Marshall

events.name: Maryland Terrapins at Nebraska Cornhuskers

headlines.description: — Dwayne McDougle III's 81-yard interception return for a touchdown sparked Nebraska in the first half, and the Cornhuskers all but shut down Maryland after that in a penalty-filled 48-23 victory Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dwayne McDougle's pick-6 turns game Nebraska's way in a 48-23 victory over Maryland

events.name: UTEP Miners at New Mexico Lobos

headlines.description: — Toa Fa’avae threw for 249 yards and three touchdowns as New Mexico routed UTEP 61-7 on Saturday in a Mountain West opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Toa Fa’avae's 3 TDs, New Mexico defense lead Lobos over UTEP 61-7

events.name: Purdue Boilermakers at Illinois Fighting Illini

headlines.description: — Freshman kicker Jacobo Echeverria Lozano booted three field goals and Antonio Harris scored a late touchdown on a 1-yard run as Purdue defeated Illinois 24-17 Saturday in a Big Ten Conference game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacobo Echeverria Lozano, Antonio Harris propel Purdue to 24-17 victory over Illinois

events.name: Oregon State Beavers at Colorado State Rams

headlines.description: — Braden Atkinson threw five touchdown passes, three to Jesse Legree, and Oregon State defeated Colorado State 56-26 on Saturday in the Pac-12 opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Atkinson and Legree team for big passing day in Oregon State's 56-26 win in Pac-12 opener

events.name: Texas Southern Tigers at Florida Atlantic Owls

headlines.description: — Leonard Farrow returned two kickoffs for touchdowns, Caden Veltkamp threw for four scores — three of them to Kelby Valsin — and Florida Atlantic routed Football Championship Subdivision-member Texas Southern 66-10 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leonard Farrow's 2 kickoff return TDs highlight Florida Atlantic's 66-10 rout of Texas Southern

events.name: Arkansas Razorbacks at Texas A&M Aggies

headlines.description: — KJ Edwards ran for two touchdowns and Marcel Reed threw for 170 yards and ran for a score to lead Texas A&M to a 34-7 win over Arkansas on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texas A&M powers past Arkansas 34-7 behind KJ Edwards’ 2 TDs

events.name: UTSA Roadrunners at Rice Owls

headlines.description: — Will Henderson III had a touchdown run and Michael Petro kicked three field goals to help UTSA hold off Rice 16-14 on Saturday night in an American Conference opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Will Henderson III, Michael Petro help UTSA hold off Rice 16-14 in American Conference opener

events.name: Georgia Southern Eagles at Coastal Carolina Chanticleers

headlines.description: — Max Johnson threw two of his three touchdown passes in the fourth quarter to help Georgia Southern beat Coastal Carolina 31-24 on Saturday night in the Sun Belt Conference opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson throws a pair of 4th-quarter TD passes to lift Georgia Southern past Coastal Carolina 31-24

events.name: UL Monroe Warhawks at South Alabama Jaguars

headlines.description: — Jared Hollins threw for 321 yards and three touchdowns and South Alabama never trailed in a 52-35 win over Louisiana-Monroe on Saturday in a Sun Belt Conference opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hollins throws 3 TD passes, South Alabama beats Louisiana-Monroe 52-35

events.name: Temple Owls at South Florida Bulls
Army Black Knights at Louisiana Tech Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Dylone Brooks rushed for 119 yards and a touchdown to help Louisiana Tech hold on for a 31-29 victory over Army on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylone Brooks has TD run, TD catch to help Louisiana Tech fend off Army 31-29

events.name: Arkansas State Red Wolves at Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns
Fresno State Bulldogs at Washington State Cougars

headlines.description: — Wide receiver Josiah Freeman scored on a reverse and Fresno State beat Washington State 23-6 on Saturday night in the inaugural game for both teams in the new-look Pac-12 Conference.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fresno State wins Pac-12 debut, beats Washington State 26-6

events.name: Baylor Bears at Arizona State Sun Devils

headlines.description: — DJ Lagway threw for 306 yards and four touchdowns to lead Baylor to a 55-19 rout of Arizona State on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lagway throws 4 TD passes to lead visiting Baylor to a 55-19 rout of Arizona State

events.name: Texas State Bobcats at San Diego State Aztecs

headlines.description: — Jaylon Hawkins returned the opening kickoff of the second half for a touchdown, Cameron Cooper had a 32-yard pick-6, and short-handed San Diego State beat Texas State 31-29 on Saturday night in the inaugural Pac-12 Conference game for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hawkins' 96-yard KOR for TD, Cooper's pick-6 help San Diego State beat Texas State 31-29

events.name: Cincinnati Bearcats at Arizona Wildcats
San José State Spartans at Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors

headlines.description: — Luke Weaver was 19-of-28 passing for 246 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions and San Jose State beat Hawaii 20-16 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Weaver throws 2 TD passes, San Jose State wins 6th straight against Hawaii, 20-16
